This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|pale]] skin with dark mottled spots on their forehead.<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> a member of this species served as a [[Padawan|student]] of the [[Jedi Order]], training alongside the [[Jedi]] [[Jecki Lon]] under the tutelage of the [[Jedi Master|Master]] [[Lakshay]] at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] just prior to the [[Mission to Khofar]].<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Day (episode)|fourth episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Alex García López]].<ref name="The Acolyte" />
